name: scriptengine-intruder
description: Rejects closed-set members that are not a named item of the requested set for the subject (text = precision_filter state JSON).

not_named_member.instructions: The text describes one candidate member of a requested set for a fiction-wiki subject (fields set_requested, subject, candidate, extracted_row, candidate_page, mentions_on_subject_pages). Is the candidate NOT a named member of that set for that subject (a generic trait, the wrong kind of thing, another character's, or non-canon)?

criteria.true: Not a named member of the set for this subject
criteria.false: A named member of the set for this subject
